data.one_liner: Core Dart framework for building high‑performance web servers with routing and WebSocket support.
data.what_it_does: Relic provides a type‑safe API for handling HTTP requests and responses, a built‑in trie router, middleware, static file handling and integrated WebSocket support. It aims to be a modern replacement for Shelf with better performance and developer ergonomics.
use_when: You need to implement a custom backend service or API in Dart.
You want typed request/response handling and built‑in routing/WebSocket support.
You prefer a Shelf‑like API but with performance improvements and hot‑reload friendliness.
avoid_when: You only need a client‑side HTTP library.
You are building a Flutter UI‑heavy app and need UI widgets or state‑management solutions.
You require a full‑stack solution with storage, authentication, or database integration out of the box.
strengths: Integrated static file and WebSocket handling
weaknesses: May be overkill for simple endpoints

alternatives.name: shelf
alternatives.why_pick_it: Mature, widely used server framework with many middleware packages.

alternatives.name: http
alternatives.why_pick_it: Lightweight client‑side HTTP library if you only need to make requests.

alternatives.name: web_socket_channel
alternatives.why_pick_it: Focused WebSocket client/server support without full server framework.
